The `prepare()` function copies and injects SCSS files into the build tree, which is the intended functionality of this theme-fixing package. All operations are confined to the build environment and result in static theme assets with no runtime payloads or network activity.

No suspicious commands, obfuscated code, or unauthorized data exfiltration mechanisms are present. The package does not execute arbitrary downloaded code at build or install time, nor does it access sensitive system files. The operations are transparent, auditable, and consistent with the package's stated purpose.
